__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
__broaden__.αὐτῶν: αὐτός — self; gen. pl.: ’their own’ (reinforcing a possessive) · also plain neut. gen. pl. personal pronoun, not reinforcing a possessive: ’them’ (λήσομαι αὐτῶν ’I will forget them’, of things said) · also intensive with a noun: ’of the heroes themselves’ (αὐτῶν ἡρώων) · also with the article, ’the same’: τοκήων τῶν αὐτῶν ’the very same parents’
__broaden__.γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive with δῖα: ’heavenly-one of women’ · also partitive with ἀρίστη: ’best of women’ · also possessive gen. with a noun: ἔργα γυναικῶν ’the works of women’
__broaden__.δεύεται: δεύω — wet, moisten; pres. 3 sg. mid. with retained acc. (πτερὰ δεύεται): ’wets its (own) wings’ · also pres. 3 sg. mid./pass.: ’is drenched’ (ὄμβρῳ δεύεται ’is drenched by rain’) · also δεύομαι (= δέομαι) — lack, be without, + gen.: νόου ... ἐσθλοῦ δεύεται ’lacks good sense’
__broaden__.λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’ · also gen. with a noun: ’of the people’ (ποιμένα λαῶν ’shepherd of the people’) · also governed by ἐκ: ἔκ ... λαῶν ’from the people’
__broaden__.λύει: λύω — loose, dissolve; pres. 3 sg. (of an assembly): ’dismisses’ · also of quarrels: νείκεα λύει ’settles disputes’
__broaden__.μίν: μιν — him; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν), accented μίν, subject of the inf. ἀνάξασθαι in indirect statement · also fem. ’her’, object of a verb or participle: καί μιν ἔτισ’ ’and honoured her’; μίν ... εἰσορόωντες ’looking on her’
__broaden__.οὗ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. gen. sg.: ’whose’ (= Attic οὗ) · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐξ οὗ ’since, from the time when’ · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own; masc. gen. sg. agreeing with a noun (οὗ πατρὸς ’her own father’s’)
__broaden__.περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’) · also + gen., of place, physically ’around, encircling’ (περὶ σπείους γλαφυροῖο ’around the hollow cave’), distinct from the comparative ’beyond’ sense above · also + dat. in the fixed idiom περὶ κῆρι ’exceedingly, at heart’ (περὶ κῆρι τιμήσουσιν ’will honor him at heart’) · also + dat., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ χροῒ ’about the skin’) · also adverb of place, no case: ’round about’ (περὶ δ’ ἕρκος ἐλήλαται ’and round it a fence is driven’)
__broaden__.τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg. · also fem. gen. sg. with the force of a relative: ’of which’ (τῆς ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ’of which one part is a drying-ground’)
__broaden__.τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc./neut. dat. sg.; also relative: ’in which’ · the relative dat. sg. also serves as an instrumental, ’with which’ (τῷ δάμνησι ’with which she overpowers’) · also adverbial ’therefore, and so’ (τῷ οὔ τινα οἶδα ’so I know no one’)
__broaden__.ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg. · also the city Athens: εὐρυάγυιαν Ἀθήνην ’wide-streeted Athens’
__broaden__.ἀθανάτους: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. acc. pl., substantival: ’the immortals’ · also adjectival, ’deathless’, agreeing with a noun (κύνες ... ἀθανάτους ὄντας)
__broaden__.ἀργύρεον: ἀργύρεος — silver, made of silver; adj., masc. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἀργυροῦν) · also neut. nom./acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (ἀργύρεον ὑπερθύριον ’a silver lintel’)
__broaden__.ἄλλη: ἄλλος — other, another; fem. nom. sg., adverbial in the idiom ἄλλυδις ἄλλη ’one this way, another that’ · also plain adj., fem. nom. sg.: ’other’ (οὔ τις ... ἄλλη ’no other woman’)
__broaden__.ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
__broaden__.ἐρέεινε: ἐρεείνω — question, ask; impf. 3 sg. act., unaugmented: ’questioned, was questioning’ · also pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’question!’ (μηδ’ ἐρέεινε ’and do not question’)
__broaden__.ἔλθοι: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. opt. 3 sg. (wish): ’may... come’ · also in a conditional protasis: ’if ... should come’ (εἰ καί ποθεν ἄλλοθεν ἔλθοι)
__broaden__.ἕτερον: ἕτερος — the other (of two); masc./neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., ’one (part)’, correlative: ἕτερον μὲν θειλόπεδον ... ἑτέρας δέ ’one part a drying-ground ... other parts’
__broaden__.ἱστοὺς: ἱστός — mast; masc. acc. pl. · also loom, web: ἱστοὺς ὑφόωσι ’weave at the looms’
__broaden__.ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
__broaden__.ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that, when; with the optative introduces a wish: ’so may…’ (unaccented; accented ὥς / ὣς is ’thus’) · also ὡς + unaugmented ὄφελον + inf., an unfulfillable wish: ’would that...’ · also ὡς + opt., a purpose clause (= ἵνα): ’so that’ (ὡς τὸν χόλον ἐξακέσαιτο ’so that he might appease the anger’) · also exclamatory ὡς + adj. + inf.: ’how (good, etc.) it is to...’ (ὡς ἀγαθὸν ... λιπέσθαι ’how good a thing it is to be left behind’) · also plain ὡς + indic., ’as’ (ὡς σὺ κελεύεις ’as you command’) or ’how’ in an indirect question (ὡς ἐπὶ πόντον ἐλεύσομαι ’how I shall come upon the sea’) · also ὡς ἄν + subj., a purpose clause: ’so that’ (ὡς ἂν μὴ κλαίουσα κατὰ χρόα καλὸν ἰάπτῃς ’so that you might not mar your fair skin with weeping’) · also ὡς δ’ ὅτε introducing an epic simile, ’as when’, its clause taking indic. or ἄν/κε + subj. for a general case: ὡς δ’ ὅτ’ ἂν ... φανήῃ ’as when ... should appear’ · also comparative ’like’, placed after the noun it compares (ἀνέμου ὡς πνοιή ’like a blast of wind’) · also ὡς εἰ ’as if, like’ (ὡς εἰ πτερὸν ἠὲ νόημα ’as if a wing or a thought’)
__broaden__.ὦρτο: ὄρνυμι — stir up, rouse; mid./intr. aor. 3 sg. ὦρτο, root aorist: ’arose’ (of a wind springing up) · also of a person: ’set out, started’ (ὦρτο πόλινδ’ ἴμεν ’set out to go to the city’)
__broaden__.ᾗσι: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; fem. dat. pl.: ’in his own (mind)’ (φρεσὶν ᾗσι) · also relative, fem. dat. pl.: ’for those toward whom’ (ᾗσι τ’ ἐὺ φρονέῃσι ’for those toward whom she is well disposed’)
